ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Pluto

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.
